newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - Dec 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the South African press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government is planning to return the land of the former homelands to the people who have the right to occupy it, in what will be South Africa's largest land transfer, involving almost 13 percent of the country's land mass.

- The slow start to government's housing programme is estimated to have pushed South Africa's burgeoning backlog to more than 2.5 million units -- although the official estimate is 1.5 million units -- analysts say.
- Foreign bankers are expecting economic policy fireworks from government in the first quarter of next year -- the only way in which another meltdown in the rand can be avoided.
- Hopes for a peaceful 1997 in KwaZulu Natal were dealt a serious blow after gunmen killed six people in an execution-style shooting in South Africa's Zulu heartland on Saturday night.
- Rescuers on Sunday called off their search for 28 seamen lost in the South Atlantic after their ship, carrying sugar from Brazil to Iraq, sank.
- The death toll on South Africa's roads is expected to top the 1,000 mark as holidaymakers throughout the country start returning home.
